tool.name: Kreeli – Transcription
tool.description: Live transcription of microphone and system sound with speaker recognition and summary.
tool.long_description: Transcribes meetings from microphone and system sound live – only with the consent of all participants. Speech recognition by a connected provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, Deepgram …) or completely offline with Whisper local. Speaker recognition, optional encrypted speaker profiles (with their own notice, Art. 9 GDPR) and a summary by an assistant. Only text is stored, never the recording.
ts.deps: Transcription needs Python packages for audio access (numpy, soundcard, about 20 MB). They go into the shared package folder of the AI tools.
ts.nobot: The transcript needs a provider with speech recognition (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Deepgram or AssemblyAI). It can be connected in the settings under AI assistants.
ts.threshold_tip: From which similarity two parts count as the same person. Higher = stricter (more new speakers), lower = more lenient.
ts.recording_banner: RECORDING – microphone and system audio are being transcribed. All participants must be informed.

ts.consent.title: Consent before recording
ts.consent.head: Conversations may only be recorded with the consent of everyone involved.
ts.consent.body:
Secretly recording non-public speech is a criminal offence in Germany (§ 201 StGB) and prohibited in many other countries. Under the GDPR, processing needs a legal basis, usually the consent of all participants.

During recording, the microphone and/or system audio are sent in parts to "{provider}" and converted to text there. To tell speakers apart, voice features are computed on this computer (in memory only). The text is saved, not the recording.

Speaker profiles (permanently stored voice features with names) are biometric data. They are only created if allowed below and the person concerned has explicitly agreed; they are always stored encrypted.
ts.consent.agree: All participants have been informed and agree to recording and transcription.
ts.consent.profiles: Use and create speaker profiles (only with the explicit consent of those concerned)
ts.consent.profiles_always: Always use and create speaker profiles, without the separate notice
ts.pnotice.title: Store speaker profiles permanently
ts.pnotice.head: Voice profiles are biometric data (Art. 9 GDPR).
ts.pnotice.body:
A speaker profile permanently stores voice characteristics of a person together with their name, so the person can be recognised in later recordings. Under Art. 9 GDPR such data belongs to the special categories of personal data and may generally only be processed with the explicit consent of the person concerned.

You alone as the user are responsible for the lawfulness. OmniWrench stores the profiles encrypted and only on this computer; they can be deleted at any time under “Speaker profiles”. Data subjects have the right of access and erasure.
ts.pnotice.accept: I have read this notice, will obtain the required consents and take responsibility.
ts.consent.notice: Notice: this conversation is being recorded to create a transcript and converted to text with an AI service. Please object briefly if you do not agree.
